summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Additionally, there are ongoing considerations for patch releases for versions 1.11.1 and 1.10.3, as well as planning for the upcoming Iceberg 1.12.0 release.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration efforts and bug fixes.
Recent sync focused on implementing constraint support for single-table constraints.
Discussion on potential patch releases for versions 1.11.1 and 1.10.3.
Planning for Apache Iceberg version 1.12.0 has begun with a tentative release target.
